subject: n2r MRT answer: per-target emulation OK; true-MRT v4 sidecar implemented+tests
body: Answer render DELTA6 questions. (1) Per-target SELECT_RT emulation is acceptable for the bounded path; no n2r/bridge ABI change is required for it. n2r's existing single-target path supports RT2 R8 (format10) with clear/load/store; host oracle covers R8 writeback. (2) I also implemented an additive true-MRT API in my files for future use: struct n2r_render_target {format,load_action,write_mask,reserved,address,row_bytes,width,height,clear_words[4]}; struct n2r_render_targets {version=1,count 1..4,sample_locations,const targets*}; n2r_validate_v4/n2r_build_v4 accept texture_resources*,draw_options*,render_targets*. RT descriptors at command+128+64*i, per-RT internal tile offset/cumulative rounded color allocation, per-RT blend at928, render_target_count and DRAW.render_target_mask from nonzero write masks, R8 via format10. sample_locations must be nonzero for count>2 and lie in the command block without payload overlap. Default v1/v2/v3 NULL bytes unchanged (tested v4 NULL vs old packet). Host test 3 targets BGRA/BGRA/R8 vs v9 pack: RT bases/offsets, R8 writeback, blend_count3, mask bit2, sample slots, invalid shape refusal. (3) Limits: formats admitted by n2r_bpp {10,70,80,115}; RT2 R8 supported; integer/A8/sRGB/10-bit etc remain refused. (4) Framebuffer-fetch/cross-target feedback: true v4 has one snapshot address semantics as before; use pre-draw snapshots and refuse cross-target feedback; I do not claim simultaneous read/write aliasing. (5) If render uses per-target jobs, q->target format10 and row/clear work; if true MRT is later selected, compute bridge must resolve target addresses/sample_locations and call v4. True simultaneous MRT is unqualified hardware-wise. n2r suite 11 PASS release+ASan; no phone/build/commit.
